# Deckpress 2.0 release notes

Deckpress turns Markdown slide decks into PDF files.

Version 2.0 embeds each font that permits embedding. When a font license forbids embedding, Deckpress skips that font and prints a warning naming it. The --notes flag adds one page of speaker notes after each slide.

The maintainers tested version 2.0 on the 40 sample decks included in the Deckpress repository. For 38 decks, the generated PDF rendered identically to the same deck in Chrome. The remaining two decks used fonts that forbid embedding.

Deckpress 2.0 requires Node.js 20 or later; version 1.x required Node.js 16.

# Retry rate

This dashboard summarizes the 200 completed jobs in the bundled acceptance test suite. A job requires a retry when its first execution fails and the runner executes it again.

Retry rate is the percentage of completed jobs that required at least one retry. Six of the 200 jobs required a retry, so the retry rate is 3%. The dashboard highlights retry rates above 5%.

# Delivery retries

Courier sends notification jobs to delivery workers. When a worker fails to deliver a notification, Courier schedules another delivery attempt.

Courier now routes these retry attempts through the amber lane. This reduces duplicate deliveries.
